name: astra-gate-plugins
description: Source of the Astra v2 plugins; packed tarballs are uploaded to the plugin market service (astra-gate-web).

scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs --no-test >/dev/null; for d in packages/*/; do [ -f $d/astra.plugin.json ] && (cd $d && npm test --silent) || true; done
